entities.name: Pipe
entities.description: One of the five legendary kirin kami of Kamigawa, representing red, who argues for non-interference in the Kami War.

entities.name: Silverbeard
entities.description: One of the five kirin, who plays a chess-like game with Pipe.

entities.name: Scale
entities.description: A kirin who retorts to Pipe and calls the scout a fool.

entities.name: Dew
entities.description: A kirin who vanishes from the teahouse.

entities.name: Thorn
entities.description: A kirin who remains in the teahouse with Pipe at the end.

entities.name: Kirin kami
entities.description: Five legendary kami who meet every 1,000 years.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War between kami and mortals during which the kirin met.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: Location with a painting containing the teahouse.

entities.name: Sokenzan
entities.description: Mountain range where Pipe in sword form was found in a snowbank.

entities.name: Bandit scout
entities.description: A scout who finds the sword, tricks his warchief into oni, and becomes a great bandit chief.

entities.name: Godo
entities.description: Great-grandson of the scout, highly thought of by the bandit tribes.

entities.name: Oni
entities.description: Feral beasts with barbed tails and iron tusks that kill the warchief and his men.

entities.name: Akki
entities.description: Goblin-like creatures who kill the bandit chief.

events.summary: As the Kami War begins, the five kirin meet in a teahouse inside a painting in Minamo; Pipe argues for non-interference.
In sword form Pipe is found by a scout, who tricks his warchief into the oni's ravine and takes the sword and pendant.
events.quote: The scout waited until the echoes of their screams died

events.summary: The scout becomes chief with the flaming sword and unites tribes in an alliance, winning victories over samurai forts.
events.quote: the scout had risen higher than any chief before him, bringing several tribes together in an alliance

events.summary: The scout is killed by akki after the sword slips from his hand.
events.quote: The Akki smashed his head with a rock moments later and he fell to his death.

events.summary: Scale calls the scout a fool and accuses Pipe of manipulation; the kirin disperse and Pipe vanishes in flame.
events.quote: Pipe then disappeared in a blistering hot wave of flame and smoke

relations.note: Accuses Pipe of manipulating humans and kami
relations.quote: Pipe always seeks to manipulate humans and Kami

relations.note: Not killed; scout wielded Pipe as a sword
relations.quote: when the scout drew the sword, it flared with an unearthly flame
